hints.title: Initial Letter Morphology
hints.text: Inspect the initial letter of each word to determine suffix rearrangement before appending positional letters.

hints.title: Vowel vs Consonant Rules
hints.text: If the word begins with a vowel, append ma. If it begins with a consonant, remove the first letter, append it to the end, and then append ma.

hints.title: Positional Index Appending
hints.text: Append a sequence of character a whose length equals the 1-indexed word position, then join transformed tokens with single spaces.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of words in sentence
complexity.notes: Single pass transforming words with quadratic string output from suffix expansion.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeated string concatenations without list accumulation introduce quadratic allocation overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Output string requires O(N^2) space for 1 + 2 + ... + N appended letters.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use set of vowels for O(1) membership check and 1-based indexing for appended letters.
